title: Members and Space teams find their own events on one My events page

source.ref: Owner request 2026-11-17: make sure any user or space user can easily find their events from their console

detail: A member's events were scattered: RSVPs only on each event page, and the Events host box's Manage button pointed at /admin/events, which is host-gated, so a member who had posted an event was turned away. A Space's events lived only inside its calendar, and the Space console's Events link opened the community-wide list. Fix: /events/mine lists Going (RSVPs), Hosting (hosted or posted, drafts included, each with Manage) and, per Space the member owns or admins, its upcoming events with a door into that Space's calendar. Read through the session client (RLS already scopes every read to the member's own rows). Linked from the Events header (signed in), the Events host box (replacing the broken Manage), the Events hub row, the site map and the Space console. The member left rail is code (FQ_SHORTCUTS), owned by the navigation rework, so no left-menu row is added here. /events/mine is reserved from the member event rewrite.

verify.note: Fails on main: there is no /events/mine and the host box links to /admin/events. Passes once the page exists and every console links to it.
